crossRefs.note: Yahweh God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”
The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there…
The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken…
Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

translations.web: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
translations.bsb: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.
translations.kjv: Neither was ➔ the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
translations.asv: for neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man:
